newsitem.title: USA: Mississippi jobless rate falls to 4.7 pct in April.
newsitem.headline: Mississippi jobless rate falls to 4.7 pct in April.

text.p: Mississippi's unemployment rate dropped to 4.7 percent in April from 5.8 percent in March, the state Employment Security Commission said.
The jobless rate was the state's lowest since April of 1974, when it dipped to 4.0 percent.
The commission attributed the improvement to gains in construction, retail trade and services employment, and to a tapering off of job cuts in the manufacturing sector.
Lafayette County had the state's lowest unemployment rate for April, 1.4 percent, and Issaquena County had the highest, 15.7 percent.
